notablePrerequisites: The Eternity Elevator has twenty or more charge counters on it.
description:
Activate The Eternity Elevator by tapping it, adding at least twenty mana of any color.
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Voltaic Key.
Activate the Voltaic Key token by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping The Eternity Elevator.
Repeat.
